confidence.rationale: The official HTML menu and restaurant-linked Toast catalog were reopened and substantiate the narrow positive-ingredient evidence and catalog drift. The official carry-out PDF remained unavailable for independent extraction, so complete menu enumeration, complete allergen arrays, negatives, and cross-contact conclusions remain unverifiable.

confirmedFindings: Affected baseline items: 5:deep-fried-vegetable-dumpling, 37:padseeew, 38:padthai, 44:pomelosalad, 47:savory-egg-noodles-topped-with-flavorful, 52:steamed-minced-pork-and-shrimp-dumplings, 61:tomkha, 63:udontomkha, 66:wontonsoup, and 68:yellowcurry. Reconciliation covers all 70 baseline items exactly once: 6 variant_match/mismatch, 14 normalized_match/mismatch, 9 exact_match/mismatch, 2 artifact/not_applicable, and 39 normalized_match/accurately_unavailable.

The official menu explicitly supports narrow positives for Pad See Ew (egg and soy), Pad Thai (egg and peanut), Pomelo Salad (shellfish and peanut), Bamee (egg), Kanom Jeeb/steamed pork-and-shrimp dumplings (shellfish), and Wonton Soup (shellfish). Terra correctly preserved these positives instead of erasing them.

The official menu does not support the full baseline arrays for the ten affected items. It supplies neither a complete allergen disclosure nor sufficient evidence for negatives or cross-contact status.
The baseline tree-nut claims for Tom Kha and Yellow Curry are unsupported culinary promotion from coconut and should not be treated as restaurant-issued tree-nut evidence.

Deep-fried Vegetable Dumpling has no explicit ingredient evidence supporting its six-allergen baseline array. Udon Tom Kha has no fixed shellfish ingredient, and Wonton Soup supports shellfish but not the baseline wheat/gluten claims.
The restaurant-linked Toast catalog currently includes Chicken Satay, Pad Broccoli, Pla Pad Black Pepper, and Bai Kao Bowl outside the frozen catalog, confirming current-product and count drift.
The official catering page establishes an additional current catering surface, while the inaccessible carry-out and catering PDFs prevent full enumeration.
The multi-service, PDF/image, count-drift, current-only, duplicate-presentation, non-exact-reconciliation, parser/repair, low-confidence, and scout-risk gates remain substantively supported.
The deterministic cross-contact gate is only a review trigger. No primary source establishes cross-contact or its absence, so Terra correctly left that gate unresolved.
rejectedFindings: Reject any interpretation of Terra finding F2 that all ten affected baseline items lack every valid positive; six items retain explicit narrow positives.
Reject using the incomplete menu or inaccessible PDFs to infer complete allergen arrays, allergen absence, or cross-contact status.
Reject coconut as sufficient evidence for the application's tree-nut classification.
Reject wheat or gluten from the word “wonton” alone, and reject shellfish for Udon Tom Kha unless a shrimp-containing configuration is specifically selected.
Reject treating the triggered cross-contact gate as affirmative evidence of shared equipment or contamination.

additionalEvidence.summary: Current official menu explicitly names egg, soy sauce, peanuts, shrimp, fish, cashew, and other ingredients for specific dishes but contains no allergen legend, complete matrix, negative claims, or cross-contact disclosure.

Current linked ordering catalog confirms identity, narrow named-ingredient positives, and food products omitted from the frozen catalog, including Chicken Satay, Pad Broccoli, Pla Pad Black Pepper, and Bai Kao Bowl.
Official page confirms a current party-sized catering product surface and links a catering menu, but does not itself provide allergen conclusions.
Officially linked carry-out PDF could not be independently reopened or extracted, preserving the verification limitation.

summary: The packet's effectiveOutcome is upheld as low_confidence. Terra's central evidence distinction is sound and its reconciliation preserves valid explicit positives, but the baseline still requires repair to remove unsupported complete-array semantics while retaining six item-specific positive ingredient findings. Current menu drift and the additional catering surface are confirmed; cross-contact remains unknown.
